key_insight: An H₂-based optimization framework designs riblet profiles to maximally suppress velocity fluctuations at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: Systematic riblet-shape design could reduce reliance on exhaustive geometry sweeps when developing turbulence-control surfaces.
method: Model riblets using volume penalization in linearized Navier–Stokes dynamics.
Recast penalization as structured state feedback.
Optimize fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations at constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal wall-normal profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative performance metrics or experimental validation.
watch_item: Turbulence attenuation in the linearized model does not by itself establish drag reduction in nonlinear flows.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
